Up to 10,000 researchers get six months of Antigravity's highest usage tier plus Gemini 4 Argon, free; Argon normally needs Google AI Ultra at $249.99 a month, so the grant is worth half a year of Ultra-level agent usage. Apply through the interest form at antigravity.google/use-cases/science while signed in to the Google account you want upgraded, giving your institution, institutional email, a public lab or personal page, an ORCID or Google Scholar profile, and a 6-12 month research summary that must not be confidential or proprietary. Review is weekly and capacity-limited: from 13 October 2026 more than 27,000 applications arrived, about 3,000 were granted first and unsuccessful applicants are not told. Once in, install the Science plugin from the Customizations market to query AlphaGenome, AlphaFold Database, UniProt, PubChem, ChEMBL and 30+ life-science databases; fields run beyond biology to medicine, chemistry and materials, physics and fusion, quantum, climate, neuroscience, maths, computer science, engineering, social science, agriculture and economics, as long as the work is non-commercial.
Conditions
Non-commercial research only; applicants must be staff or students at a university, degree-granting institute, non-profit research institute or national lab (faculty, postdocs, researchers, PhD and master's students; no option for undergraduates); an ORCID or Google Scholar profile is required; the summary must not contain confidential or unpublished data; capped at 10,000 places, reviewed on a rolling basis with only successful applicants contacted; only the Google account used on the form is upgraded.

Together AI serves PrismML's Ternary Bonsai 27B on serverless inference with input, cached input and output all priced Free under the model ID Prism-ML/Ternary-Bonsai-27B. It is a ternary low-bit build of Qwen3.6 27B: every language weight takes one of three values with an FP16 scale per group of 128, measuring 1.71 bits per weight and roughly 9.4x smaller than FP16, and it claims 95% of the original quality (80.49 average over 15 thinking-mode benchmarks, with MATH-500 99.20, AIME 2025 90.84 and HumanEval+ 93.90). It carries a 262K context, a 4-bit vision tower for images and documents, JSON mode and tool calling, with recommended temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95 and top_k 20. Conditions
Create a Together AI account and API key (endpoint Prism-ML/Ternary-Bonsai-27B) and call it through the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions route; the vendor publishes no free quota, rate limit or end date, so terms can change.

A skills contest where AI agents build software for cash: each bounty states the task, prize and metrics, entrants use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or similar to produce the work, submit a public repo at a fixed commit plus the AI session log that produced it, and the platform checks the two against each other before scoring every entry twice in the same sandbox. Prizes sit in USDC escrow on Solana (open source and checkable), and winners claim them to their own wallets rather than being paid out. Since 9 November 2026 it has paid $5,967.50 to 413 accounts. From 18 November a top-1,000 finish without a prize slot earns a share of an extra pool, larger with rank, usually under a cent but accumulating across bounties, claimable to a Solana wallet at $0.25. Live bounties run $35 to $1,666 ($35 poems, $50 spot-the-difference and posters, $100-250 news images and data forecasts, $250 GTA 6 covers and trophy guides, $500 video edits and a 4KB Python chess engine, $1,000/$1,325/$1,666 higher-end tasks).
Conditions
Register and connect a Solana wallet; submissions need a fixed-commit public repo plus the AI session log, which must pass the automatic check; most bounties are free and any fee is stated; model costs are yours; only ranked prize slots pay, with the top-1,000 share as a small extra; claim within at least seven days of winning, pass sanctions screening and file US tax forms where required; unclaimed prizes return to the funder.

  3. Build the work with your own AI coding agent and submit the repository at one commit with the session transcripts
  4. Wait for the automatic checks and two sandbox runs, then press Claim on your profile to move the USDC to your own Solana wallet
Earnings are entirely unguaranteed: the platform calls a bounty a competition rather than a wage, an entry outside the paid places earns nothing, and participation rewards are often under a cent; model calls are your own cost and can exceed the reward; submitting requires public source and full session transcripts, exposing your code and prompts; claiming needs a sanctions screen and possibly a US tax form, and unclaimed rewards return to the funder; the platform only launched in November 2026, so its long-term policies and payout reliability are untested.

  3. Copy the device-specific update URL into your router or client (FRITZ!Box, Synology, cron and others)
  4. For HTTPS, issue a Let's Encrypt certificate via the DNS challenge with acme.sh or Certbot on a machine you control
The subdomains stay the property of IPv64.net, so free limits, suffixes and terms can change at any time; free subdomains can't be hosted on Cloudflare directly (IPv64 only supports NS records and does not guarantee it, and it does not work as commonly claimed), so treat any "Cloudflare-ready" advice as unverified; three domains are enough for a home network, NAS or self-hosted service entry point but not for a real site; it cannot act as a registrar or transfer domains out; it is a small German company with no SLA, so a shutdown means moving your DNS yourself.

Number validity is counted separately from the starter bundle and starts at 120 days, extended by a top-up of HK$20+ or a designated purchase, which the community usually does at about HK$60 a year. A first eSIM transfer is free and a nice number costs HK$8 (transfer alone is HK$28). The FAQ allows activation outside Hong Kong; local service needs real-name registration (passport or permit, manual review of 1-2 hours up to 48), which is optional for roaming data only, and after registration incoming texts are free abroad within validity while travelling in the mainland.
Conditions
New customers buy at the SoSIM web store or mini-program from HK$33; install and activate within 60 days of payment; local Hong Kong service needs real-name registration (up to 48 hours) while roaming data does not; number validity from 120 days, extended by a HK$20+ top-up or designated purchase; incoming texts on mainland roaming depend on plan status.

Archived, as the panel errored in tests on 23 November 2026. Nodaroo, a small host launched in November 2026 at nodaroo.com with machines in Frankfurt and Mumbai, released free containers on 22 November: sign in to free.nodaroo.com with Discord for one box with 200% shared CPU, 6GB of RAM, 50GB of NVMe, one slot and a German node, without a card or KYC. At 6GB it offers five times Altare's 10GB of disk and spread fast. Entry is Discord-only, with OAuth scopes identify, email and guilds.join that also join its server, and an invite link adds 100 points, 25 to the referrer, for more CPU, RAM, disk and slots. Its Discord lists recruitment tiers: Light at 18 people or 300 views for 24GB and four cores, Premium at 25 or 600 for 32GB and six, and Extreme at 35 or 1,000 for 48GB and eight. Technically it is a container panel, Heliactyl in front and Pterodactyl behind, not a bare KVM: no root or native SSH, only a web console and SFTP on 2022, ports limited to those assigned, no Docker-in-Docker and 200% CPU as a shared allowance. By 23 November the panel returned an error asking to retry or contact support, with the community reporting signup and creation failures.
Conditions
Archived and ended: Discord sign-in with no card or KYC; one free workspace per new account; the site link opens the basic tier while invites add 100 points; 200% shared CPU, 6GB, 50GB NVMe, one slot, German node; a container rather than KVM without root or native SSH and with panel-assigned ports only; the panel errored on 23 November 2026.

Archived, as the official page now says the free network trial has ended. Vodafone UK's London's Best Network seven-day trial gave non-customers ordering online or scanning London street QR codes a free pay-as-you-go Plus eSIM with 50GB of UK data, 500 UK minutes and 500 texts for seven days from the order date, ending at 23:59 on day seven, without changing numbers or giving a card. Launched on 6 May 2025 and taken to Glastonbury and other festivals, it was widely reposted around August 2026 for the free +44 number that receives codes. Ordering needed the device located in London, a UK contact number that receives texts and is not on Vodafone or VOXI, a postcode matching a London address, one per device and the form open 8:00 to 22:00, with no roaming during the trial. The community warns that Vodafone UK blocks EIDs readily, so keep it off a main phone. Rechecked on 22 November 2026, the page only sells SIM-only plans now with no end date published, so the cutoff is recorded as 30 September 2026.
Conditions
